Tenant Dc Exclusion Resource Delete Data Centre Exclusion
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dcExclusions/:dcId

Deletes a Zscaler data center (DC) exclusion configuration based on the specified ID. The DC exclusion configuration ID can be obtained by sending a GET request to /dcExclusions.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
dcId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the DC exclusion configuration

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
